main.description: An affinity edge: something the author saved, liked, watched or bookmarked on a named platform. Extends community.lexicon.bookmarks.bookmark, which carries the same act in a form every bookmark app already understands; this record adds the platform and the kind of interaction, which that lexicon has no field for. It deliberately carries NO title, description or thumbnail: those belong to the platform and the creator, not to the author of this record.

subject.description: Canonical URL of the thing the interaction is about.

subjectRef.description: A namespaced platform identifier, for subjects with no stable public URL. Supplied alongside `subject`, never instead of it.

platform.description: Where the interaction happened, as a bare domain where one exists: youtube.com, instagram.com, tiktok.com. Mirrors teal.fm's musicServiceBaseDomain.

interactionKind.description: like, save, bookmark, favorite, watch, subscribe, … The author's own act, not a metric.

createdAt.description: When the interaction happened on the source platform, where known; otherwise when the record was written.

tags.description: The author's own tags. Never platform-derived metadata.

bookmark.description: The community.lexicon.bookmarks.bookmark record this edge extends, when one was written.

foreignId.description: A namespaced identifier in some other catalogue, after the my.skylights.rel pattern.

ref.description: Namespace of the identifier, e.g. youtube:video, tiktok:post.
